title: On Determinacy for Cut and Choose Games of Uncountable Length
summary: We obtain results on cut and choose games for complete Boolean algebras. Zapletal proved that there is a Boolean algebra $\mathbb{B}$ such that $\mathcal{G}_ω^\textsf{candc}(\mathbb{B})$, the version of the game which ends on the $ω$'th round, is undetermined. We prove that, assuming the consistency of a proper class of supercompact cardinals, the limit version $\mathcal{G}^{\textsf{candc}}_{< λ}(\mathbb{B})$, in which there are $λ$-many rounds but no concluding round, is consistently determined for all complete Boolean algebras $\mathbb{B}$ and all successor cardinals $λ$.
